verdict.rationale: Eqvista's cap table page says users can "configure vesting schedules for founders and employees," and the pricing page lists ESOP management, so the product has its own vesting-schedule capability. None of the story's specifics are evidenced: cliffs, milestone-based vesting, exit acceleration, and automatic vested-vs-unvested tracking are not mentioned. Missing for 10: documented cliff configuration, milestone-based vesting, single/double-trigger acceleration on exit, automatic vested/unvested tracking, independent or hands-on corroboration.
